releases.name: v1.3.0: measured model scores and plan tiers
releases.body:
This release selects each agent's model from public benchmark data and enforces exactly what each OpenCode plan can use.

## Added

- **Measured scores:** `model-scores.json` is generated from public intelligence indices and matched to the catalog through `canonical_model_id`. The generator reports unmatched models and records provenance in `_meta`.
- **Selection funnel:** eligibility → intelligence gate → cost → speed → reliability → archetype weights. `opencode-router scores --top` prints the gate, the excluded models, and the winner per archetype.
- **Reliability pillar:** seven-day uptime from the OpenCode status feed, a neutral prior of 85 for untracked models, and an optional `minUptime` floor.
- **`scores` command:** `--write`, `--check`, `--top`, `--from`, `--url`, `--band`, and `--json`. `npm run scores` wraps it.

## Changed

- **Plan tiers:** `free` uses `opencode/*` $0 models only; `go` adds the `opencode-go` subscription; `go-plus` also allows metered `opencode/*` pay-as-you-go models.
- **Dedupe:** a model that exists under both namespaces keeps its subscription twin when both are paid, so the Go plan can still route to it.
- **Free fallback:** on Go Plus, appending the free overflow model no longer drops the metered paid pick.
- **Scorecard:** shows the plan tier, a tier column, and `metered` instead of `unlimited` for paid Zen models. `--verbose` shows the source of each score.
- **Eval:** skips unauthenticated providers, adds a status column, uses a 2000-token budget, parses `reasoning`, flags truncation, and records `orderMeasured`.

## Update

Type `/routing-update` in OpenCode, then restart OpenCode. Or, with OpenCode closed:

```bash
npx --prefer-online @s-berdia/opencode-router@latest update
```

See [how models are selected](https://github.com/s-berdia/Opencode_router/blob/main/docs/model-selection.md) and the [plan tiers](https://github.com/s-berdia/Opencode_router#plan-tiers).

releases.name: v1.2.0: shared Go allowance
releases.body:
All OpenCode Go models share one usage allowance. Before this release, the router moved an agent to another Go model at 85%, and that model used the same allowance. Now the agents move to a free model.

## Changed

- **Shared allowance:** the router estimates one Go allowance for all Go models. Each message uses its cost divided by the monthly limit of its model. The router tracks 3 rolling windows: 5 hours (20% of the monthly allowance), 7 days (50%), and 30 days (100%).
- **Free model at the end of each list:** on Go and Go Plus, the last model of each agent's list is the best free model (if `privacy.freeModelsOk` is not `false`).
- **Failover:** at 85% of a window, or after a usage-limit error, the `plan`, `build`, `general`, and `explore` agents use their free model. They go back when the use falls or the 1-hour cooldown ends. A plain rate-limit or overload error still benches only one model.
- **Status:** `/routing-status` shows the estimated allowance use, a cooldown line, and the new state `free-fallback`. In `status --json`, the `usage` object is replaced by `allowance`.

## Update

Type `/routing-update` in OpenCode, then restart OpenCode. From 1.0.x, run `npx @s-berdia/opencode-router@latest update` with OpenCode closed.

After the update, the allowance estimate starts at 0%.

See [How the router changes models](https://github.com/s-berdia/Opencode_router/blob/main/USAGE.md#how-the-router-changes-models) and the new [known limits](https://github.com/s-berdia/Opencode_router/blob/main/USAGE.md#11-known-limits).

No code change.

- The npm page now shows the new README: badges, the one-line install with `opencode plugin @s-berdia/opencode-router --global`, and the update steps.
- The npm description and keywords are new.

To update from 1.1.0, type `/routing-update` in OpenCode, then restart OpenCode.

releases.name: v1.1.0: update checker
releases.body:
OpenCode installs an npm plugin one time and then uses its cached copy. It does not get new versions automatically. This release adds an update checker.

## New

- **Update check:** at most once each 24 hours, the router asks npm for the newest version number. If a newer version exists, OpenCode shows a toast, and `/routing-status` and `/refresh-routing` show a line.
- **`/routing-update`:** removes the old copy from the OpenCode cache. Restart OpenCode, and it installs the newest version. The same command is available in a terminal: `npx @s-berdia/opencode-router@latest update`.
- **Setting `updateCheck`:** set `"updateCheck": false` in `router.config.json` to stop the check.

## Update from 1.0.x

Version 1.0.x has no update checker, so do this one time:

1. Close OpenCode.
2. Run `npx @s-berdia/opencode-router@latest update` in a terminal.
3. Start OpenCode again.

## Privacy

The update check sends one request to `registry.npmjs.org` for the version number. It sends no other data.

## Fixed

- The router slash commands now run on the free small model. Before, they ran on the `build` model and used a small part of your Go quota.
